title: Brain Abscess
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Brain abscess is a focal collection of purulent material within the brain parenchyma, which can arise as a complication of a variety of local cranial or remote systemic infections, trauma, or surgery. The manifestations of brain abscess depend on the site, size, and the immune status of the patient.
